R-S-portfolio-for-O-RU-testing_MARCH_2025_R-S_INTERNAL_ONLY_SHORT › 重點摘要
- 來源更新 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023）的 O-RU testing portfolio 視角，將重點放在 2025 年的 [[O-RU tester market and funding]]、[[R&S PVT360A O-RU testing]]、[[O-RU NES testing]]、[[VIAVI O-RU Tester]] / [[VIAVI TM500]] integration、competitor positioning 與 NTIA funding opportunities。
- Slide 2 說 O-RU tester 客戶範圍包含 traditional TOP3 RAN vendors：[[Ericsson]]、[[Nokia]]、[[Samsung]]；O-RAN market entrants：[[Kyocera]]、[[Mavenir]]、[[Tejas]]、[[Fujitsu]]、[[NEC]]、[[ADI]]、[[Qualcomm]]、[[Battelle]]；以及 testing budget limited 的 [[Phy-tunes]]、[[GXC]]、[[Eridian]]、[[University of Georgia]]，與 DAS companies：[[Amphenol]] / Andrew、[[SOLiD]]、[[Samji]]、[[HFR]]。
- Slide 2 說 US government 透過 [[NTIA NOFO2]] / SRFA#1 funding program 資助 O-RU commercialization；來源描述 2 years project、targeting commercially available Jan 2027、O-RU conformance testing ongoing、field testing starts 1HCY2026、mass-production EoY CY26 / BoY CY27。
- Slide 3 把 [[Open RAN]] ecosystem 分為 traditional infrastructure providers、radio subsystem manufacturers、chipset / reference designers、industry organizations、test labs、test equipment manufacturers、network operators 與 government funding。
- Slide 4 將 key test focus areas 從 R&D 到 field testing 分為 RF design / verification / integration、power management、digital design、production testing、regression、operator test、beamforming / Massive MIMO、fronthaul conformance、timing / sync / signal integrity、OTA、QoS / QoE、3GPP compliance、interoperability、end-to-end、functional / baseline testing、network benchmarking、site testing / troubleshooting 與 network synchronization。
- Slide 5 列出 O-RU testing general instrumentation：[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S NGT3600]]、[[R&S OSP200]] / [[R&S OSP300]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]，並標示 Q2CY2025。

- 相較 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023），本來源是 2025-03 的 short version，新增 O-RU tester market / funding、PVT360A cost-optimized positioning、NES / EE、M-MIMO with BFM、competitor positioning、VIAVI VAR agreement 與 NTIA funded labs 資訊。
- 補強 [[O-RU testing]]：既有頁面已整理 August 2023 的 O-RAN WG4 / 3GPP / VIAVI + R&S solution；本來源新增 2025 年 portfolio segmentation、PVT360A 與 VSA/VSG 兩種 offer path、production / regression / certification 的定位差異。
- 補強 [[Network energy saving]]：既有頁面由 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]] 建立 network energy saving 概念；本來源把 NES 具體連到 O-RU、ETSI traffic models、RTO6、NGP / NGT、VIAVI TM500 O-RU Tester、ADI Titan demo 與 up to 40% energy savings claim。
- 補強 [[VIAVI O-RU Tester]]：既有頁面只由 August 2023 portfolio 支撐；本來源新增 PVT360A setup、VSA/VSG setup、TM500 O-RU Tester、O-DU emulator、TMA、VAR agreement 與 lab adoption 線索。

answer.text:
Evidence-backed chain: the passages support an Aerospace & Defense requirement around deployed 5G private-network resilience in Smart Jamming / EW environments, but they do not directly state that this requirement must be tested with a Vector Network Analyzer [13].
### Recommended first sell
R&S ZNL20: 20 GHz, 2-port Vector Network Analyzer with 3.5 mm connectors; VNA frequency range is 5 kHz to 20 GHz [15][17].
R&S ZNA67EXT: 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz; the system consists of one R&S ZNA67 VNA and up to four external test sets [25][26].
### Product and option alignment table
| Product line | Market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required VNA capability | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNL20 | Aerospace & Defense Test context: deployed 5G private-network resilience under Smart Jamming / EW, including frequency hopping for 5G resilience without DUT modification.[13] | Frequency coverage up to 20 GHz; 2-port setup; 3.5 mm connector interface.[15][17] | 2-port VNA capability from 5 kHz to 20 GHz with 3.5 mm male test-port connectors.[17] | [13][15][17] | No passage directly says ZNL20 is required for A&D EW / Smart Jamming / 5G resilience testing. |
### Scenario chain
| Scenario | Chain from market requirement to measurable parameter to VNA capability | Unverified item |
|---|---|---|
| A&D 5G private-network resilience | Market requirement: deployed 5G private networks need resilience in Smart Jamming / EW environments.[13] → Measurable parameter supported in the VNA passages: frequency range / port / connector coverage.[15][17][26] → Required VNA capability candidate: 5 kHz to 20 GHz, 2-port, 3.5 mm for ZNL20, or 10 MHz to 110 GHz, 1.0 mm system for ZNA67EXT.[17][25][26] | The passages do not directly connect Smart Jamming / EW resilience testing to VNA measurements. |
### Inference
【推論】If the A&D test task requires RF path or component characterization within 20 GHz, the supported VNA capability to map is ZNL20’s 5 kHz to 20 GHz, 2-port, 3.5 mm configuration; this inference combines the A&D resilience context with ZNL20 specifications.[13][15][17]
